info.title: Text Utils API
info.summary: Reverse text, count words and check palindromes.
info.description: Three small text utilities, each one a single `POST` request with a JSON body.

post.description: Return the text with its characters in reverse order.

x-codeSamples.label: Python
x-codeSamples.source:
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "http://localhost:8000/reverse",
    json={'text': 'Hello, Mintlify!'},
)
print(response.json())

x-codeSamples.label: JavaScript
Go

post.description:
Count words, unique words, characters and lines.

Words are runs of letters, digits, apostrophes and hyphens. Comparison
for `unique_words` ignores case.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/word-count \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"text": "to be or not to be"}'

x-codeSamples.label: Python
x-codeSamples.source:
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "http://localhost:8000/word-count",
    json={'text': 'to be or not to be'},
)
print(response.json())

post.description: Check whether the text reads the same forwards and backwards.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:

  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"text": "A man, a plan, a canal: Panama"}'
